newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end off, mirroring U.S. falls.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end off, mirroring U.S. falls.

text.p: Caracas stocks reversed four straight days of gains to fall in tandem with the dropping U.S. market, traders said.
Local players dominated the session's light trade as "foreign investors kept their attention focused on New York makrets," said Multinvest broker Mario Simosa.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed off 0.12 percent at 6,242.01 points as 16.8 million shares traded, worth 1.9 billion bolivars ($4 million).
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile slipped 0.43 percent to 95.81 points as CANTV took a hit, closing off 28.00 bolivars at 2020.00.
"It was weak foreign markets that brought the bolsa down," said Profimerca broker Miguel Gonzalez.
Among traded issues, 23 fell, seven rose and six closed flat.
